decision_conditions:
Heritage Statement is required for properties where the proposal affects designated and/or non-designated heritage assets or their setting (Listed Buildings, Buildings of Townscape Merit, fall within a conservation area or have an Article 4 direction attached to it)

http://www.richmond.gov.uk/make_a_planning_application (Step 3)

description: External alterations to the existing dwelling, modern extension and outbuilding, including re-rendering and painting; installation of a green roof to the existing extension; replacement of windows and doors; replacement of the first-floor Juliet balcony railing; replacement of a sash window with timber French doors and installation of a perforated balcony deck to the existing Juliet balcony; replacement of the street access and principal entrance doors with timber Dutch barn doors; and associated refurbishment works.
